style.styleTitle: Premier Decorations Ltd 1m Battery Op Lit FlexiBrights Pyramid LED Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Add a colourful illuminated feature to your Christmas decorations with this 1 m FlexiBrights® Pyramid Tree with Star. The stylish design is enhanced by 146 rainbow LEDs and features 8 multi action effects, including combination, waves, sequential, slow glow, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash and steady on. Battery operated, it requires 3 x AA batteries (not included) and includes a convenient timer function with 6 hours on followed by 18 hours off, making it easy to enjoy your display each day. Perfect for adding a vibrant finishing touch to Christmas displays, this illuminated pyramid tree creates a bright focal point wherever it is placed.
